functions.notes: The wrapper passes FLinearColor by value; the native body constructs FName 'Color' and writes the vector parameter to IconMID at offset 0x478 if non-null.
The native body converts Extents to a linear color with alpha 1 and writes vector parameter 'Interact Extents' on IconMID if non-null.
The native body initializes 'PulseStartTime', then when IconMID and component world exist writes that world's TimeSeconds as a scalar.

reviewed.review: Wrapper copies four floats; 0x141f49240 initializes FName 'Color' before checking IconMID and passes the color unchanged to the vector material setter. 0x14433b290 forms global FMaterialParameterInfo; reflection identifies the parameter struct as LinearColor.

Wrapper copies the FVector argument; 0x141f48200 initializes 'Interact Extents' and checks IconMID. 0x142c47190 copies XYZ and supplies alpha 1.0; 0x14433b290 forms global FMaterialParameterInfo for the vector setter.

The native exec initializes 'PulseStartTime' before testing IconMID, resolves its component world via cached world or 0x1440b3260, then reads world+0x540 TimeSeconds and passes it to scalar setter 0x14433acd0.
